```{r root, include=FALSE}
# This notebook lives in scripts/; everything else is resolved from the repository root.
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())   # used when knitting and in notebook mode
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4.8, dpi = 150)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "n/a")
source(here::here("scripts", "00_setup.R"))   # packages, CRS, paths and params, exactly as in the pipeline

# RStudio runs every chunk in this file's folder (scripts/), so a working directory set in one chunk does not
# carry over to the next. Make the repo-relative paths from 00_setup.R absolute, so that no chunk depends on it.
abs_path <- function(p) if (grepl("^([A-Za-z]:|/|~)", p)) p else here::here(p)
for (v in c("path_pts", "path_kml_ref", "dir_proc", "dir_gee", "dir_shp", "dir_fig", "dir_ras", "dir_tab", "dir_wbt"))
  assign(v, abs_path(get(v)))

# A pipeline output, or a clear message about which script makes it.
need <- function(f, script = NULL) {
  if (!file.exists(f))
    stop("Missing ", f, if (!is.null(script)) paste0(". Run scripts/", script, " first (see README)"), ".", call. = FALSE)
  f
}
fmt <- function(x, d = 1) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")

# A figure the scripts saved in outputs/figures, or a visible note saying which script makes it.
show_fig <- function(name, script) {
  f <- file.path(dir_fig, name)
  if (file.exists(f)) knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(f), rel_path = FALSE)
  else knitr::asis_output(paste0("*Figure ", name, " not found: run scripts/", script, ".*"))
}
```

```{r numbers}
# ---- Boundary ---------------------------------------------------------------
forest      <- st_read(need(file.path(dir_proc, "kitobo_forest.gpkg"), "01_boundary.R"), quiet = TRUE)
forest_ha   <- area_ha(forest)
pts_raw     <- distinct(read_csv(need(path_pts), show_col_types = FALSE), X, Y)
hull_tab    <- read_csv(need(file.path(dir_tab, "01_hull_ratio_sensitivity.csv"), "01_boundary.R"), show_col_types = FALSE)
this_hull   <- hull_tab[abs(hull_tab$hull_ratio - params$hull_ratio) < 1e-9, ]
has_outline <- nrow(this_hull) == 1 && !is.na(this_hull$iou_vs_outline)
outline_ha  <- if (has_outline) this_hull$hull_ha - this_hull$hull_beyond_outline_ha + this_hull$outline_missed_ha
bnd_text    <- if (params$boundary == "hull")
  paste0("concave hull (ratio ", params$hull_ratio, ") of the ", nrow(pts_raw), " unique survey points") else
  "polygon traced in Google Earth"
crs_file    <- file.path(dir_tab, "01_crs_check.csv")
crs_tab     <- if (file.exists(crs_file)) read_csv(crs_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
crs_ok      <- if (!is.null(crs_tab)) crs_tab[crs_tab$points_read_as == crs_pts, ]
crs_alt     <- if (!is.null(crs_tab)) crs_tab[crs_tab$points_read_as == "EPSG:32737", ]
ctx_file    <- file.path(dir_tab, "01_landscape_context.csv")
ctx_tab     <- if (file.exists(ctx_file)) read_csv(ctx_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---- Hydrology --------------------------------------------------------------
dem        <- rast(need(file.path(dir_wbt, "dem.tif"), "02_dem_hydrology.R"))
streams    <- st_read(need(file.path(dir_shp, "Kitobo_Streams.shp"), "02_dem_hydrology.R"), quiet = TRUE)
heads      <- st_read(need(file.path(dir_shp, "Kitobo_ChannelHeads.shp"), "02_dem_hydrology.R"), quiet = TRUE)
twi        <- rast(need(file.path(dir_ras, "kitobo_twi.tif"), "02_dem_hydrology.R"))
dem_km2    <- as.numeric(global(!is.na(dem), "sum")) * prod(res(dem)) / 1e6
stream_km  <- sum(as.numeric(st_length(streams))) / 1000
stream_in  <- sum(as.numeric(st_length(suppressWarnings(st_intersection(streams, forest))))) / 1000
heads_in   <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(heads, forest)) > 0)
twi_vals   <- as.vector(values(twi, na.rm = TRUE))
twi_forest <- as.numeric(exact_extract(twi, forest, "mean"))
twi_pct    <- 100 * ecdf(twi_vals)(twi_forest)

# ---- Fire and regeneration: filled in once scripts/03 has run on the Earth Engine exports ----
firms_file  <- file.path(dir_proc, "kitobo_firms.gpkg")
sev_file    <- file.path(dir_gee, "Kitobo_Severity.tif")
dnbr_file   <- file.path(dir_gee, "Kitobo_dNBR.tif")
burn_file   <- file.path(dir_tab, "burn_fraction_by_class.csv")
bnd_file    <- file.path(dir_tab, "burn_by_boundary.csv")
series_file <- file.path(dir_tab, "nbr_recovery_series.csv")
trend_file  <- file.path(dir_tab, "nbr_recovery_trend.csv")
summ_file   <- file.path(dir_tab, "nbr_recovery_summary.csv")
rec_png     <- file.path(dir_fig, "03_regeneration_nbr.png")
has_firms   <- file.exists(firms_file)
has_burn    <- file.exists(sev_file) && file.exists(burn_file)
has_bnd     <- file.exists(bnd_file)
has_rec     <- all(file.exists(c(series_file, trend_file, rec_png)))
has_gap     <- FALSE

fire_by_date <- NULL                 # VIIRS detections within 1 km of the forest, by date
if (has_firms) {
  fires <- st_read(firms_file, quiet = TRUE)
  near  <- fires[as.numeric(st_distance(fires, st_union(forest))) <= 1000, ]
  if (nrow(near))
    fire_by_date <- near %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(acq_date, name = "detections") %>% arrange(acq_date)
}
if (has_burn) {
  burn <- read_csv(burn_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "class", values_to = "fraction") %>%
    mutate(class_id = as.integer(sub("frac_", "", class)),
           Severity = c("Unburned", "Low", "Moderate-low", "Moderate-high", "High")[class_id + 1]) %>%
    arrange(class_id) %>%
    transmute(Severity, `Share of forest (%)` = round(100 * fraction, 1), `Area (ha)` = round(fraction * forest_ha, 1))
  burned_pct <- sum(burn$`Share of forest (%)`[burn$Severity != "Unburned"])
  burned_ha  <- burned_pct / 100 * forest_ha
  lowmod_pct <- 100 * sum(burn$`Share of forest (%)`[burn$Severity %in% c("Low", "Moderate-low")]) / burned_pct
  # dNBR background inside and outside the forest (the surroundings green up between the two windows)
  if (file.exists(dnbr_file)) {
    dn     <- rast(dnbr_file)
    in_f   <- !is.na(values(rasterize(vect(st_transform(forest, crs(dn))), dn, field = 1, background = NA))[, 1])
    dn_val <- values(dn)[, 1]
    dn_in  <- median(dn_val[in_f], na.rm = TRUE)
    dn_out <- median(dn_val[!in_f], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
bnd_tab <- if (has_bnd) read_csv(bnd_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
if (has_rec) {
  rec_series <- read_csv(series_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  trends     <- read_csv(trend_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  ts_all     <- trends[grepl("^Whole", trends$measure), ]
  ts_gap     <- trends[grepl("^Gap", trends$measure), ]
  has_gap    <- file.exists(summ_file) && nrow(ts_gap) == 1
}
if (has_gap) rec_sum <- read_csv(summ_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---- Key-results table --------------------------------------------------------
pending <- "Pending: needs the Earth Engine export (see README)"
r_fire <- if (!is.null(fire_by_date)) {
  peak <- fire_by_date[which.max(fire_by_date$detections), ]
  paste0(format(min(fire_by_date$acq_date), "%d %b %Y"), " to ", format(max(fire_by_date$acq_date), "%d %b %Y"),
         "; peak ", format(peak$acq_date, "%d %b %Y"), " (", peak$detections, " detections)")
} else if (has_firms) "No VIIRS detections within 1 km of the forest" else
  paste0("Mid-February 2026 (as given for this analysis; the Sentinel-2 windows end ", format(as.Date(params$gee_pre[2]), "%d %b"),
         " and restart ", format(as.Date(params$gee_post[1]), "%d %b"), ")")
b_fire <- if (has_firms) "NASA FIRMS VIIRS (375 m), detections within 1 km of the forest" else
  "As given for this analysis; not verified against NASA FIRMS detections"
r_rec <- if (has_gap) {
  if (is.na(rec_sum$recovered_month)) "Burned ground not yet back to the unburned level" else
    paste0("Burned ground back within 10% of unburned ground by ", format(rec_sum$recovered_month, "%b %Y"),
           " (", fmt(rec_sum$months_fire_to_recovered, 1), " months after the fire)")
} else if (has_rec) paste0("Whole-forest NBR shows no trend (", fmt(ts_all$slope_per_month, 4), " per month)") else pending
b_rec <- if (has_gap) paste0("Burned minus unburned NBR gap ", fmt(rec_sum$trough_gap, 2), " at its trough (",
                             format(rec_sum$trough_month, "%b %Y"), "); Theil-Sen ", fmt(ts_gap$slope_per_month, 3),
                             " NBR per month over ", ts_gap$n_months, " months") else
  "Theil-Sen slope of monthly NBR since the fire"
key <- tibble(
  Indicator = c("Forest boundary", "Survey coordinate system", "Catchment analysed", "Modelled surface drainage",
                "Mean TWI in the forest", "Fire date", "Burned share of the forest", "Recovery of burned ground"),
  Result = c(
    paste0(fmt(forest_ha), " ha"),
    "Arc 1960 / UTM zone 37S",
    paste0(fmt(dem_km2), " km2"),
    paste0(fmt(stream_km), " km (", fmt(stream_km / dem_km2, 2), " km/km2); ", nrow(heads), " channel heads, ", heads_in, " inside the forest"),
    paste0(fmt(twi_forest), " (above ", fmt(twi_pct, 0), "% of the catchment)"),
    r_fire,
    if (has_burn) paste0(fmt(burned_pct), "% (", fmt(burned_ha), " ha)") else pending,
    r_rec),
  Basis = c(
    paste0(bnd_text, if (has_outline) paste0("; the traced Google Earth outline encloses ", fmt(outline_ha), " ha")),
    if (!is.null(crs_ok) && nrow(crs_ok) == 1)
      paste0("Median distance to the Google Earth outline ", fmt(crs_ok$median_m), " m (", fmt(crs_alt$median_m, 0), " m if read as WGS84)") else "EPSG:21037",
    paste0(params$catchment_buffer / 1000, " km buffer around the forest; DEM cells ", fmt(res(dem)[1]), " m, interpolated from ~30 m data"),
    paste0("Streams start at ", params$stream_area_km2, " km2 of contributing area (provisional). Surface runoff, not springs"),
    paste0("Catchment median ", fmt(median(twi_vals)), ". TWI flags saturation-prone positions"),
    b_fire,
    paste0("Sentinel-2 dNBR above 100", if (has_bnd && nrow(bnd_tab) > 1)
      paste0("; ", fmt(bnd_tab$burned_ha[2]), " ha (", fmt(bnd_tab$burned_share_pct[2]), "%) inside the traced outline")),
    b_rec)
)
```

# Summary

```{r key-table}
knitr::kable(key)
```

- The forest boundary used throughout is the `r bnd_text`: **`r fmt(forest_ha)` ha**.
- The survey coordinates are in **Arc 1960 / UTM zone 37S**, not WGS84. Read as WGS84 the forest is displaced by about 315 m.
- Modelled drainage is **surface runoff**, not the springs that feed this groundwater forest. `r heads_in` of `r nrow(heads)` channel heads fall inside the forest.
- `r if (has_burn) paste0("About ", fmt(burned_pct), "% of the forest (", fmt(burned_ha), " ha) burned in the mid-February 2026 fire; ", fmt(lowmod_pct, 0), "% of the burned area is low or moderate-low severity.") else "Fire results are pending the Earth Engine exports (section 3)."`
- `r if (has_gap) paste0("Burned ground fell about ", fmt(abs(rec_sum$trough_gap), 2), " NBR units below unburned forest in ", format(rec_sum$trough_month, "%B %Y"), if (!is.na(rec_sum$recovered_month)) paste0(" and was back within 10% of it by ", format(rec_sum$recovered_month, "%B %Y"), ", about ", fmt(rec_sum$months_fire_to_recovered, 1), " months after the fire."), " This is recovery of the spectral signal; woody structure takes much longer (section 5).") else "Regeneration results are pending the Earth Engine exports (section 4)."`

# 1. Study area and boundary

Kitobo Forest is a small groundwater and riverine forest near Taveta, Taita-Taveta County, Kenya, in the Tsavo landscape. The forest polygon used throughout is the `r bnd_text`, which encloses **`r fmt(forest_ha)` ha**.

```{r boundary-map, out.width = "100%", fig.cap = "Forest boundary used (green), survey points (red) and, where available, the Google Earth outline (gold)."}
show_fig("01_boundary_map.png", "01_boundary.R")
```

`r if (has_outline) paste0("The Google Earth outline of the forest encloses ", fmt(outline_ha), " ha. The hull covers about ", fmt(100 * (1 - this_hull$outline_missed_ha / outline_ha), 0), "% of it (intersection over union ", fmt(this_hull$iou_vs_outline, 2), "), and ", fmt(this_hull$hull_beyond_outline_ha, 0), " ha of the hull lie outside it. The survey points sit only on the perimeter, so a concave hull with a low ratio cuts chords across the interior; the forest is usually quoted at about 150 ha, which matches the hull rather than the traced outline.")`

```{r hull-table}
if (has_outline)
  knitr::kable(transmute(hull_tab,
    `Hull ratio` = hull_ratio, `Hull area (ha)` = round(hull_ha, 1), `IoU with outline` = round(iou_vs_outline, 2),
    `Outline missed (ha)` = round(outline_missed_ha, 1), `Hull beyond outline (ha)` = round(hull_beyond_outline_ha, 1)),
    caption = "Concave hull of the survey points at different ratios, compared with the area enclosed by the Google Earth outline (ratio 1 is the convex hull).")
```

```{r hull-fig, out.width = "100%", fig.cap = "Concave hulls (green lines) over the area enclosed by the Google Earth outline (yellow)."}
if (has_outline) show_fig("01_hull_vs_outline.png", "01_boundary.R")
```

**Coordinate system.** `r if (!is.null(crs_ok) && nrow(crs_ok) == 1) paste0("The survey points sit a median ", fmt(crs_ok$median_m), " m (90th percentile ", fmt(crs_ok$p90_m), " m) from the Google Earth outline when read as Arc 1960 / UTM 37S, against ", fmt(crs_alt$median_m, 0), " m (", fmt(crs_alt$p90_m, 0), " m) when read as WGS84 / UTM 37S. The gap is the Arc 1960 to WGS84 datum shift at this location, so the points are treated as Arc 1960 and transformed to WGS84 / UTM 37S for all metric work.") else "The survey points are recorded in Arc 1960 / UTM zone 37S and are transformed to WGS84 / UTM 37S for all metric work."`

```{r context}
if (!is.null(ctx_tab))
  knitr::kable(transmute(ctx_tab, Layer = layer, `Nearest feature` = nearest, `Distance from the forest (km)` = distance_km),
               caption = "Landscape context: Kitobo lies outside the Tsavo ranch and settlement layers.")
```

# 2. Surface hydrology

Flow paths were derived from an open DEM (`elevatr`, `r fmt(res(dem)[1])` m cells interpolated from roughly 30 m data) over a `r params$catchment_buffer / 1000` km buffer around the forest (`r fmt(dem_km2)` km2). WhiteboxTools breached depressions, routed flow (D8), and extracted streams where a cell drains at least `r params$stream_area_km2` km2 (a provisional threshold). Channel heads are the upstream-most nodes of the network, and the topographic wetness index (TWI) combines upslope contributing area and slope.

```{r hydro-fig, out.width = "100%", fig.cap = "Modelled surface drainage (blue), channel heads (red) and the forest (green) over a hillshaded DEM."}
show_fig("02_hydrology.png", "02_dem_hydrology.R")
```

The network has `r nrow(streams)` segments totalling `r fmt(stream_km)` km (`r fmt(stream_km / dem_km2, 2)` km/km2) and `r nrow(heads)` channel heads, `r heads_in` of them inside the forest. About `r fmt(stream_in, 2)` km of modelled channel cross the forest.

```{r twi-map, out.width = "100%", fig.cap = "Topographic wetness index around the forest (red outline) with modelled streams (white); colours are stretched between the 2nd and 98th percentile."}
show_fig("02_twi_forest.png", "02_dem_hydrology.R")
```

The same map for the whole catchment is saved as `outputs/figures/02_twi_catchment.png`. Mean TWI inside the forest is `r fmt(twi_forest)`, above `r fmt(twi_pct, 0)`% of the catchment's cells (catchment median `r fmt(median(twi_vals))`). TWI is the better guide to water availability for this forest: **the modelled streams are surface runoff and erosion drainage, not the springs that feed it.** Over flat terrain the channel heads and the drainage density depend strongly on the DEM and on the stream threshold, so they should be read as indicative.

# 4. Regeneration

`r if (!has_rec) "*Pending: run the Earth Engine script, download the monthly NBR stack to data/raw/gee/, then run scripts/03_fire_regeneration.R (Part C).*" else if (!has_gap) paste0("Whole-forest NBR shows no trend after the fire (", fmt(ts_all$slope_per_month, 4), " per month, p = ", fmt(ts_all$p_value, 2), ").") else paste0("Whole-forest NBR only dilutes the fire signal because just ", fmt(burned_pct, 1), "% of the forest burned, and the series also carries the seasonal cycle of the rains (Theil-Sen slope ", fmt(ts_all$slope_per_month, 4), " NBR per month, p = ", fmt(ts_all$p_value, 2), "). The recovery is therefore measured as the gap between burned and unburned ground inside the forest, which share the same vegetation and season. The gap was ", fmt(rec_sum$pre_fire_gap, 3), " before the fire, fell to ", fmt(rec_sum$trough_gap, 2), " in ", format(rec_sum$trough_month, "%B %Y"), if (!is.na(rec_sum$recovered_month)) paste0(" and was within 10% of its pre-fire value by ", format(rec_sum$recovered_month, "%B %Y"), " (", fmt(rec_sum$months_fire_to_recovered, 1), " months after the fire)."), " Over the recovery phase (", format(ts_gap$from, "%b"), " to ", format(ts_gap$to, "%b %Y"), ", ", ts_gap$n_months, " months) the Theil-Sen slope is ", fmt(ts_gap$slope_per_month, 3), " NBR per month (p = ", fmt(ts_gap$p_value, 2), "; four monthly points give a test with little power, so the p-value is only indicative).")`

```{r rec-fig, out.width = "100%", fig.cap = "Top: monthly mean NBR of the whole forest, burned ground and unburned ground; the dashed line is the fire date. Bottom: the burned-minus-unburned gap with the Theil-Sen slope from the trough to recovery (green)."}
if (has_rec) show_fig("03_regeneration_nbr.png", "03_fire_regeneration.R")
```

```{r rec-table}
if (has_gap)
  knitr::kable(transmute(rec_series, Month = format(date, "%b %Y"), `Whole forest` = round(nbr_forest, 3),
                         `Burned ground` = round(nbr_burned, 3), `Unburned ground` = round(nbr_unburned, 3), Gap = round(gap, 3)),
               caption = "Mean monthly NBR inside the forest boundary.")
```

# 5. Caveats and next steps

**Caveats**

- Modelled streams are surface runoff and erosion drainage. They are not the springs that feed this groundwater forest; pair TWI with any field-known spring locations.
- The DEM is interpolated from roughly 30 m data over flat terrain, so channel heads and drainage density are sensitive to the stream threshold and to canopy bias. FABDEM is preferred for publication.
- The boundary is a concave hull of perimeter points. `r if (has_outline) paste0("It covers about ", fmt(100 * (1 - this_hull$outline_missed_ha / outline_ha), 0), "% of the traced Google Earth outline, so burned-area *shares* refer to the hull.")` `r if (has_bnd && nrow(bnd_tab) > 1) paste0("The burned *area* hardly depends on the choice: ", fmt(bnd_tab$burned_ha[1]), " ha in the hull against ", fmt(bnd_tab$burned_ha[2]), " ha in the traced outline.")`
- dNBR classes come from temperate forests. `r if (has_burn && exists("dn_in")) paste0("Inside the forest the unburned ground is steady between the two windows (median dNBR ", fmt(dn_in, 0), "), so the classes are usable there. The surrounding savanna and fields green up as the rains start (median dNBR ", fmt(dn_out, 0), "), so the severity raster should not be read outside the forest.")`
- The burned ground's NBR recovered within about three months, in step with the long rains. NBR measures the return of green, moist cover, not woody structure, species composition or the springs, which take years to recover and need field data. The quick spectral recovery should not be reported as restoration success on its own.
- FIRMS (375 m) gives the date only; extent and severity come from Sentinel-2 (10 to 20 m). The fire date (mid-February 2026) is as given for this analysis and has not been verified against FIRMS.

**Next steps**

1. Tune the stream threshold (`params$stream_area_km2`) against imagery and any field-known channels.
2. Re-run the monthly Earth Engine export as new months arrive; the note updates when `scripts/03_fire_regeneration.R` is run again and the note is re-knitted.
3. Add field indicators of structural recovery (canopy cover, seedling counts) next to the NBR series.

# 6. Reproducibility

```{r versions}
pk <- c("sf", "terra", "tmap", "whitebox", "elevatr", "exactextractr", "trend")
knitr::kable(tibble(Package = pk, Version = vapply(pk, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), character(1))),
             caption = paste0(R.version.string, "; knitted ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "."))
```

Scripts: `scripts/00_setup.R` to `scripts/03_fire_regeneration.R`; `scripts/gee/kitobo_gee_combined_as_run_2026-10-23.js` is the Earth Engine script that produced the exports. Methods and design decisions: `docs/methodology.md`.
